# 2 Samuel Chapter 5 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 172v–173r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/2SA_005_page_001.jpg, 2SA_005_page_002.jpg | **DSS:** 4QSamᵃ (4Q51) fragments extant — online reference only

---

**5:1** And-came all [the]-tribes of-Yisra'el to David to-Chevron and-said, saying, "Behold-us, your-bone and-your-flesh [are]-we.

**5:2** Also yesterday, also the-day-before [i.e., previously], when-was Sha'ul king over-us, you were the-one-leading-out and-the-one-bringing-in Yisra'el. And-said YHWH to-you, 'You shall-shepherd my-people Yisra'el, and-you shall-be as-ruler [nagid] over Yisra'el.'"

**5:3** And-came all [the]-elders of-Yisra'el to the-king to-Chevron, and-cut the-king David with-them a-covenant [berit] in-Chevron before YHWH, and-they-anointed David as-king over Yisra'el.

**5:4** A-son of-thirty years [was] David when-he-became-king; forty years he-reigned.

**5:5** In-Chevron he-reigned over Yehudah seven years and-six months, and-in-Yerushalayim he-reigned thirty and-three years over all Yisra'el and-Yehudah.

**5:6** And-went the-king and-his-men to-Yerushalayim, to the-Yevusi, [the]-inhabitant of-the-land. And-he-said to-David, saying, "You-shall-not come in here, unless [ki im] you-remove the-blind and-the-lame" — saying, "David shall-not come in here."

**5:7** And-captured David the-fortress of-Tsiyyon — it [is the]-city of-David.

**5:8** And-said David on-that day, "All who-strikes the-Yevusi, let-him-reach through-the-water-shaft [tsinnor] — and-the-lame and-the-blind, [the]-hated-ones of-David's-soul [nephesh]." Therefore they-say, "Blind and-lame shall-not come into the-house."

**5:9** And-dwelt David in-the-fortress and-called-it [the]-City of-David. And-built David all-around, from the-Millo and-inward.

**5:10** And-went David, going and-growing-great, and-YHWH God of-hosts [was] with-him.

**5:11** And-sent Chiram king of-Tsor messengers to David, and-trees of-cedars [atzey arazim], and-craftsmen of-wood and-craftsmen of-stone of-wall, and-they-built for-David a-house.

**5:12** And-knew David that YHWH had-established-him as-king over Yisra'el, and-that He-had-exalted his-kingdom for-[the]-sake of-His-people Yisra'el.

**5:13** And-took David more concubines [pilagshim] and-wives from-Yerushalayim after his-coming from-Chevron, and-were-born again to-David sons and-daughters.

**5:14** And-these [are the]-names of-those-born to-him in-Yerushalayim: Shammua and-Shovav and-Natan and-Shelomoh,

**5:15** and-Yivchar and-Elishua and-Nefeg and-Yafia,

**5:16** and-Elishama and-Elyada and-Elifelet.

**5:17** And-heard [the]-Pelishtim that they-had-anointed David as-king over Yisra'el, and-went-up all [the]-Pelishtim to-seek David. And-heard David and-went-down to the-fortress.

**5:18** And-[the]-Pelishtim came and-spread-out in-[the]-Valley of-Refa'im.

**5:19** And-inquired David of-YHWH, saying, "Shall-I-go-up against [the]-Pelishtim? Will-You-give-them into-my-hand?" And-said YHWH to David, "Go-up, for giving I-will-give [naton etteyn] the-Pelishtim into-your-hand."

**5:20** And-came David to-Ba'al-Peratsim, and-struck-them David there, and-said, "YHWH has-broken-through [parats] my-enemies before-me as-a-breaking-through of-waters [perets mayim]." Therefore he-called [the]-name of-that place Ba'al-Peratsim [Lord/Master of-Breakthroughs].

**5:21** And-they-abandoned there their-idols [atsabbeyhem], and-carried-them David and-his-men.

**5:22** And-added again [the]-Pelishtim to-come-up, and-spread-out in-[the]-Valley of-Refa'im.

**5:23** And-inquired David of-YHWH, and-He-said, "You-shall-not go-up. Go-around to-their-rear and-come upon-them from-opposite [the]-balsam-trees [bekha'im].

**5:24** And-it-shall-be when-you-hear [the]-sound of-marching [tse'adah] in-[the]-tops of-the-balsam-trees [bekha'im], then be-quick [techarats], for then YHWH has-gone-out before-you to-strike in-[the]-camp of-[the]-Pelishtim."

**5:25** And-did David so, as YHWH commanded-him, and-struck [the]-Pelishtim from-Geva until-you-come to-Gazer.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.2 — nagid:** The term נָגִיד means "ruler/leader/prince" — distinct from *melek* (king). The people affirm David as both shepherd and *nagid*, echoing YHWH's earlier designation through Samuel.

**v.6-8 — Jebusite taunt and tsinnor:** These verses are among the most debated in Samuel. The Jebusites taunt David with the blind and lame (either disabled defenders or idol-guardians). David's response mentions the *tsinnor* — variously translated as "water shaft," "gutter," or "scaling hook." The 4QSamᵃ fragments may preserve variant readings here.

**v.20 — Ba'al-Peratsim:** The place-name etymology is characteristic of the narrator: David names the site after YHWH's breaking-through (*perets*), using the metaphor of floodwaters bursting through a dam.

**v.23-24 — bekha'im:** The בְּכָאִים are traditionally rendered "balsam trees" or "mulberry trees." The sound of marching in their tops is understood as the sound of YHWH's invisible army advancing — a theophanic marker.

*— EMET*
